Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SECTION XX 
3.1 Length — The length shall be chosen from the following: 



1 

/, mm 


1 000 


1 200 


1 500 


2 000 


2 500 


3 000 


4 000 


5 000 



3.2 Width —The width shall be chosen from the following: 



b, mm 


125 


160 


200 


250 


315 


400 


500 


630 



3.3 Height — The height shall be chosen from the following: 



/), mm 


125 


160 


200 


250 


315 


400 


500 


630 



3.4 Inclination a — Inclination a is determined as a function of grain size, specific gravity and flow 
rate of material carried.

IS: 7439 -1974 

4. Element — The element A is gas permeable intermediate porous element and may be manufactured 
from any one of the following: 

a) fabric, 

b) ceramic, 

c) sintered metal, 

d) compressed material, and 

e) synthetic material. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is in conformity with the International Standard ISO 2326-1972 'Continuous 
mechanical handling equipment for loose bulk materials — Aeroslides ', issued by International Organiza- 
tion for Standardization.
